- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1193-1230 | severity=critical | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The install step never writes `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true` to `$GITHUB_ENV` on the success path, so the build step always skips and Semble integration becomes a no-op.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers confirmed the binary path is set but the downstream `if [ "${SEMBLE_AVAILABLE:-false}" != "true" ]` guard still fires; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro explicitly disputes this, saying `install_semble.sh` already marks Semble available.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:51-64 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test uses `reviewers.index("# Assemble the default", assemble_start)` to locate the next section, and reviewers report that this raises `ValueError` against the current prompt text.
  WHY: Moonshot, qwen, and x-ai all report the substring search fails; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro says the test passes because the substring is present in the current comment, so the finding is disputed.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:306-440 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Successful Semble overflow queries no longer emit structured `SEMBLE_QUERY` telemetry, so only failure fallback logs remain.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the previous success-path logging was removed, eliminating the observable signal that distinguishes a successful Semble retrieval from no overflow or a disabled Semble path.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:96 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` defaults to `"true"` when unset, so `semble_query_block` proceeds as if Semble were available.
  WHY: Reviewers note this is the wrong fail-safe default; it is currently masked by later checks, but an unset variable should not imply availability.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1185-1199 and scripts/install_semble.sh:117-127 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The cross-pollination summary claims the Install step never sets SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true, making Semble a no-op.
  WHY: This is incorrect: install_semble.sh calls main(), which calls mark_available() on success, and mark_available() writes `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true` to `$GITHUB_ENV`.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:51-53 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The cross-pollination summary claims `test_reviewer_prompt_assembles_semble_context_in_dynamic_section` raises `ValueError` because `"# Assemble the default"` is not found.
  WHY: This is incorrect: Python `str.index` performs substring matching, and `"# Assemble the default"` is a substring of `"# Assemble the default (pass 1 / single-pass) prompt."`, so the test passes.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:306-351 and 418-439 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Successful Semble queries for overflow files are completely silent in workflow logs.
  WHY: The success path no longer emits any `SEMBLE_QUERY` log, so operators cannot distinguish successful Semble use from no overflow-file Semble triggering at all.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:96 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` defaults to `"true"` when unset.
  WHY: The guard is semantically backward; unset should be treated as unavailable even though downstream checks currently mask it.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:258, scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:448, scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:730 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `append_semble_query_section` is defined identically in three scripts.
  WHY: Any bug fix or behavior change must be applied in three places or the scripts silently diverge, producing inconsistent Semble query files.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1199-1204 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "Install semble" step never sets `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true` on the success path, so the "Build semble index" step always exits early.
  WHY: The workflow sets `SEMBLE_BIN`, but the downstream build step checks `if [ "${SEMBLE_AVAILABLE:-false}" != "true" ]` and skips Semble even when installation succeeds.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:418-440 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_run_semble_query` success path no longer emits structured `SEMBLE_QUERY` telemetry.
  WHY: The original success-path log was removed, leaving only fallback logging and breaking observability for successful overflow-file Semble retrieval.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:96 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` guard defaults to `"true"` when unset.
  WHY: That default is semantically backward; an unset variable should fail closed rather than proceed as if Semble were available.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:258-267, scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:448-457, scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:730-739 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `append_semble_query_section` function is defined identically in three separate scripts.
  WHY: Any bugfix or enhancement must be applied in all three locations or the scripts will silently diverge.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:294, scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:545,564, scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:758 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `SEMBLE_TARGETED_CONTEXT_MAX_CHUNKS`, `SEMBLE_CONFLICT_PROMPT_CHUNKS`, and `SEMBLE_REVIEWER_PROMPT_CHUNKS` are only used via shell-default expansion and are not exposed in workflow env/README.
  WHY: Operators cannot tune these chunk budgets without editing the scripts directly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1196-1223 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "Install semble" step never sets `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true` on the success path.
  WHY: The binary can be found and `SEMBLE_BIN` can be set, but the later build step still sees `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` as false/unset and exits early, making the Semble integration a no-op.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:64 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The contract test searches for `"# Assemble the default"` using `reviewers.index(...)`, but the actual comment text differs.
  WHY: `str.index()` raises `ValueError` when the substring is not found, so this test will fail against the current prompt text.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:96 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` guard defaults to `"true"` when unset.
  WHY: An unset environment variable should be treated as unavailable, not available; the current default is semantically backward.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:418-440 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Successful Semble queries for overflow files are no longer logged.
  WHY: Removing the success-path `SEMBLE_QUERY` event breaks the observability contract because operators can no longer tell whether Semble was used successfully.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
